description: Explainable OFAC sanctions name screening: screen names against the official SDN list, look up entries and explain scores. Runs locally, no API key.
name: io.github.krunalsolanki/ofac-match

data_dir.description: Optional. A folder containing SDN.CSV, ALT.CSV and ADD.CSV to use offline. Leave empty to download the current list from OFAC.

refresh_hours.description: Optional. Hours before the downloaded list is refreshed. Default 24.
